title: Concept: Actix-web error path in a response
description: An Actix error that names its internal module path in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The module path names the extractor or handler stage that rejected the request, which is precise feedback for shaping a malformed request.
applicability: Deployments that render an Actix error that names its internal module path into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The module path names the extractor or handler stage that rejected the request, which is precise feedback for shaping a malformed request.
